abstract: Maintains ultrapure water electrical resistivity and particulate purity validation records
system_message:
You are the Quality assurance manager (QA), responsible for maintaining ultrapure water electrical resistivity and particulate purity validation records for semiconductor fabrication facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: including dissolved microbubble counts·Maintains ultrapure water electrical resistivity and particulate purity validation records（SPECTRO）
information_points.content:
QA-SPECTRO-NAU：For the Vacuum membrane distillation train, evaluated including dissolved microbubble counts, ultrapure water resistivity stabilized is false based on continuous maintenance of electrical resistivity at or above 18.18 megaohm-centimeters at 25 degrees Celsius, and the submicron particle concentration is 8 particles/mL at the finished recycle distribution manifold before wafer fab entry.
QA-SPECTRO-HMU：For the Closed-loop catalytic oxidation circuit, evaluated including dissolved microbubble counts, ultrapure water resistivity stabilized is false based on continuous maintenance of electrical resistivity at or above 18.18 megaohm-centimeters at 25 degrees Celsius, and the submicron particle concentration is 10 particles/mL at the finished recycle distribution manifold before wafer fab entry.
QA-SPECTRO-B9A：For the Electro-deionization polishing sequence, evaluated including dissolved microbubble counts, ultrapure water resistivity stabilized is true based on continuous maintenance of electrical resistivity at or above 18.18 megaohm-centimeters at 25 degrees Celsius, and the submicron particle concentration is 10 particles/mL at the finished recycle distribution manifold before wafer fab entry.
